interpretationPrinciple: Preserve the Pocket section's true parent/child layering: one light campaign background spans the complete article and a local black copy panel occludes only its evidenced region. Do not translate a content child into a parent-level black section fill.

visualIntent.summary: A full-width pale Pocket campaign world acts as the shared parent field. Product identity sits directly over it; an inset black copy panel creates a local reading interruption on desktop and becomes a complete lower reading block on mobile.
hierarchy: The light campaign background is the full-section base layer at both viewports.
The logo-and-cards composite sits above that shared background in the asset region.
Desktop uses a vertically inset black panel only in the right half, leaving the parent background visible above and below.
Mobile keeps the same parent background but the full-width lower black panel completely occludes its lower portion.
Title, paragraph, and external CTA remain children of the local black panel.

mustNotImplement: a parent article or content layer filled black
two mutually exclusive left-light/right-black parent backgrounds
a desktop black panel stretched to the full 476.195px section height
desktop black extending behind the top and bottom exposed-background strips
mobile side or vertical gaps around the lower black panel

responsiveBackgroundContract.semantic: Different viewport URL bindings are implementation roles, not evidence of art-directed visual substitution.

correctedPatterns.PAT-POCKET-01: The responsive aliases share identical bytes and both serve a full-article parent background layer.
correctedPatterns.PAT-POCKET-02: Desktop remains a 50/50 content grid, but only the content columns split; the light background spans beneath both columns and the black right panel is vertically inset.
correctedPatterns.PAT-POCKET-05: The black copy anchor is a local child panel, never the parent section/background/content layer.
